name: Prone Y-T-W Raise
instructions: Lie face down with your forehead off the floor and your arms extended overhead in a Y shape, thumbs up.
Lift your arms off the floor and hold briefly, then lower. Next, do the same with your arms out to the sides in a T, then with elbows bent and pulled in to the sides in a W.
Move through the Y, T and W as one rep.
Use light effort and squeeze your shoulder blades without lifting your chest too high.
image_prompt_scene: Lying face down with the arms extended overhead in a Y.
